import subprocess, os, struct

VNCDO = r'"C:\cits\venv\Scripts\vncdo.exe" -s localhost::5900 -p cits2026'
SCREENSHOT = r'C:\cits\logs\screenshots\state_check_1920.png'
os.makedirs(r'C:\cits\logs\screenshots', exist_ok=True)

r = subprocess.run(f'{VNCDO} capture {SCREENSHOT}', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20, encoding='cp932', errors='replace')
print(f'capture rc={r.returncode}')
if r.stderr:
    print(f'capture err: {r.stderr[:200]}')

try:
    sz = os.path.getsize(SCREENSHOT)
    print(f'screenshot_size: {sz} bytes')
    with open(SCREENSHOT, 'rb') as f:
        header = f.read(32)
    if len(header) >= 24 and header[:8] == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n':
        w = struct.unpack('>I', header[16:20])[0]
        h = struct.unpack('>I', header[20:24])[0]
        print(f'screen_resolution: {w}x{h}')
        print('VNC_DESKTOP_CONFIRMED' if sz > 50000 else 'WARNING_SMALL_SCREENSHOT')
    else:
        print(f'NOT_VALID_PNG header_hex={header[:16].hex()}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'screenshot_error: {e}')
